Runtime language switching MUST be supported.
Selected locale MUST persist in the user account when authenticated and in a suitable client preference when anonymous.

UI strings MUST NOT be hardcoded in components.
Raw translation keys MUST never appear in production UI.

Semantic HTML and landmark regions MUST be used; automated and manual inspection passes.
Every action MUST be keyboard operable without a pointer.
Focus MUST be visible and meet contrast requirements.

Validation summaries and asynchronous errors MUST be announced.
Heading hierarchy MUST be logical and contain one primary page heading.
Text and interactive-state contrast MUST meet WCAG AA.
Meaningful images require localized alternative text.
Reduced-motion preference MUST disable nonessential animation.
Pages MUST reflow at 400% zoom without loss of core functionality.
Touch targets SHOULD meet WCAG 2.2 target-size guidance.
A skip link MUST be available on repeated-navigation layouts.

Data access MUST prevent injection through parameterized queries or equivalent controls.

Browser authentication MUST include CSRF protection appropriate to the session design.
CORS MUST use an explicit production allowlist.
